Brands don't want perfect ads anymore. They want raw. They want real. They want you.
This is LOOT. Brands drop paid video missions. You film them. You get paid.
Step one: enlist. Pick a codename, build your hunter profile, and once we approve you, the full app unlocks.
Step two: hit the Loot tab. Every contract shows the brand, the brief, and a guaranteed reward, before you film a thing.
Every brief comes loaded: hooks, scripts, scene-by-scene shots, do's and don'ts. Just copy, and shoot.
Tap Secure the Bag. Once the brand locks you in, the money's pre-funded and held for you.
Step three: drop the loot. Shoot it, open the Studio, and transmit your video to the brand.
On beginner missions, reshoots only happen for technical glitches, and we verify them first.
Step four: bag secured. Approved videos get paid into your Stash, and you withdraw straight to UPI.
No boss. No schedule. Just the mission. Read the rules, don't get banned... and secure the bag.
